Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this series is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux amies de la scène et de la télévision, Ruth Madoc et Su Pollard, connues pour leurs apparitions dans la sitcom Hi-De-Hi, partent à la chasse aux antiquités avec Phil Serrell et Raj Bisram. Partis de Monmouth, ville frontalière du Pays de Galles, ils se rendent à Congleton, dans le Cheshire, pour une vente aux enchères.Ruth découvre également l'incroyable infirmière du XIXe siècle - et ce n'est pas Florence Nightingale - tandis que Su visite l'ancienne ville romaine de Caerleon et trouve le temps d'affronter Phil dans un amphithéâtre.Et Su tente de résoudre un vieux mystère... Phil porte-t-il une perruque ?

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In this episode, the two candidates of the day, Thibaud Poirier and Antoine Guillou, will have one hour to realize their photo session. They will have to take the best possible photos on the imposed theme of architecture in the 12th district of Paris, and then they will have 30 minutes to edit their photos.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: François Boucq draws from morning to night in his studio, alone, as if he wanted to be more closely involved with his characters, moving from the savagery of the American West to the diplomacy of the Vatican, from the urban jungle to the news of the daily press. He has been drawing for 40 years with realism, with a precise and detailed line, a graphic finesse that makes him one of the undisputed masters of today's comics.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Netherlands painter, Rembrandt.You will discover his labour with The night round, the return of the prodigal son, Danaé.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a British painter, William Turner.You will discover his labour with London from greenwich park, child hairdo’s pilgrimage, Snow storm.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Phil Grabsky, réalisateur récompensé à plusieurs reprises, pose un regard neuf sur celui qui est sans conteste l’artiste le plus aimé au monde en utilisant les mots du peintre lui-même. Moi, Claude Monet révèle de nouvelles facettes de l’homme qui a donné naissance au mouvement impressionniste grâce à un tableau et qui fut certainement l’un des peintres les plus influents et renommés du XIXe et du début du XXe siècle. Tourné à travers l’Europe, sur les lieux où il a peint, Moi, Claude Monet est une exploration filmique inédite et intime de certains des décors cultes les plus appréciés de l’art occidental.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: The Museum of Fine Art in the city of Montpellier, in the South of France, bears the name of Francois-Xavier Fabre (1766-1837), who left his personal collection to his native town. Here you can admire the picture “Vertumnus and Permona” by Jean Ranc or “The Women of Algiers” by Delacroix. The collection includes works by the Montpellier painter Jean-Fréderic Bazille, such as his “View of a Village”, and above all paintings by Gustave Courbet, including the famous “Bonjour Monsieur Courbet”. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Edouard Vuillard (1868-1940), find our comments on the works of this founder of the Nabi movement.

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Cet épisode présente les Thermes de Vals-les-Bains, un chef-d'œuvre architectural conçu par Peter Zumthor. L'architecte a réinventé l'idée traditionnelle du bain en intégrant de manière harmonieuse l'eau et la pierre dans un dialogue poétique. Il a utilisé du quartzite local pour ancrer le bâtiment dans son environnement naturel, créant une atmosphère de calme et de sérénité. Innovant pour son époque, Zumthor a mis en scène l'eau dans tous ses états – du ruissellement au brouillard – pour offrir une expérience multisensorielle unique. Ce projet est un exemple exceptionnel de l’architecture minimaliste, combinant simplicité, fonctionnalité et une profonde connexion à la nature.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: En juin 2017, une grande exposition a ouvert à Paris au musée d’Orsay. Pour la première fois, cette exposition a réuni tous les portraits de Cézanne. Cela a été l’occasion d’analyser l’œuvre de Cézanne à l’aide d’experts internationaux et de parcourir les salles de la National Portrait Gallery de Londres et de la National Gallery of Art de Washington.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The National Gallery in London is one of the world’s greatest art galleries. It is brimming with masterpieces, an inexhaustible treasure trove of history and an endless source of stories. This film gives a voice to those whose lives have been touched by the Gallery, from the security guard to the director, including daily visitors, celebrities and members of the royal family. Claudia Winkleman, Michael Palin, Terry Gilliam, Jacqueline Wilson and Her Royal Highness Princess Eugenie reveal their deeply personal connection to the National Gallery.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Painting the Modern Garden - Monet to Matisse
programme.desc: Passionné d’horticulture, Monet reste sans conteste le maître de la peinture de jardins dans l’histoire de l’art, mais il n’était pas seul. Des artistes tels que Van Gogh, Bonnard, Picasso et Matisse ont utilisé le jardin comme thème fort de leur œuvre. Ces grands artistes, ainsi que bien d’autres noms célèbres, sont rassemblés dans une exposition innovante du Cleveland Museum of Art et de la Royal Gallery of Arts de Londres. De l’exposition elle-même à la beauté des jardins d’artistes comme celui de Monet à Giverny, nous partons en voyage pour découvrir comment le jardin moderne était utilisé pour explorer de nouvelles idées radicales et merveilleuses.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: In no way was Pierre Bonnard destined to be a painter. However, he became one of the pillars of the Nabi Movement. His work, more closely linked to emotions than to realism, is impossible to classify. It is punctuated with huge sunny landscapes, of both the Mediterranean and Normandy, with interior scenes, with nudes and self portraits. This exhibition offers you ten of the artist’s greatest paintings, such as his famous “Workshop with Mimosa” and his “Nude in Bathtub”. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: My little Museum
programme.desc: My little Museum is Art History retold through funny anecdotes and backstage trivias by Alicia Flipo. With her wacky demeanor, her inventiveness and her quirky sense of humor, Alicia stages these small Art tales so that once and for all, you could remember the Big stories!

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: L'humoriste et animateur Jim Moir et sa femme Nancy Sorrell partent en road trip dans le Kent aujourd'hui.Mieux connu sous le nom de Vic Reeves, Jim apporte sa touche d'humour unique à l'achat d'antiquités. De son côté, Nancy, mannequin et présentatrice télé, sait aussi marchander et elle est très compétitive ! Le couple est accompagné par les experts Charlie Ross et Thomas Plant.Soyez attentif au don surprenant de Jim pour deviner l’âge de presque tout, à Dixon traversant les chutes du Niagara et à une leçon de navigation par longitude.Et surtout, la mystérieuse Mme Parker fera-t-elle son apparition à la vente aux enchères ?

programme.title: Trésors Volés
programme.sub-title: The 5 Masterpieces of the Museum of Modern Art – Paris
programme.desc: In 2010, five masterpieces by Picasso, Matisse, Braque, Modigliani and Léger went missing. A year into the investigation, the police arrested the burglar, Vrejan Tomic. A repeat offender, with 11 art thefts to his name, he usually works to order. In this case, the client was Jean-Michel Corvez. Wrapped in bin bags, these unsellable works were found at the home of a third man, Yonathan Birn. How? Why?

programme.title: Trésors Volés
programme.desc: Painted by the Van Eyck brothers, ‘The Adoration of the Mystical Lamb’ or ‘The Ghent Altarpiece’ is regarded as one of the greatest masterpieces of the Flemish Primitives. Installed in St Bavon’s Cathedral in Ghent as early as 1432, it escaped theft and looting on several occasions, However, on the night of 10–11 April 1934, two panels were stolen, one of which – ‘The Just Judges’ – has never been recovered to this day, because the bishop refused to pay the ransom demanded….

programme.title: Trésors Volés
programme.desc: On the night of 17–18 October 1984, three criminals broke into the municipal museum in Semur-en-Auxois, which was not fitted with an alarm system. The joint investigation by the French and Japanese police revealed links between the Parisian underworld and the Japanese Yakuza mafia. Indeed, Shinchi Fujikuma, a Japanese gangster, had met two members of the Aubervilliers gang, Philippe-Emile Jamin and Youssef Khimoun, whilst serving time in a French prison. In 1987, the French managed to return from Japan with four of the five stolen paintings. The last one, *The Portrait of Mrs Baudot*, remained with its new owner, in accordance with the principle of ‘good faith’ guaranteed by Japanese law.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Degas : une passion de la perfection
programme.desc: Exhibition on screen nous emmène à travers les rues de Paris puis au cœur d’une superbe exposition au Fitzwilliam Museum de Cambridge, dont l’impressionnante collection d’œuvres de Degas est la plus représentative de Grande-Bretagne. Ayant bénéficié d’un accès exclusif à une grande variété d’œuvres rares, le film raconte l’histoire fascinante de la quête de perfection de Degas à travers l’expérimentation de nouvelles techniques et les leçons apprises en étudiant les grands maîtres.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Les impressionnistes - et l'homme qui les a créés
programme.desc: Ce sont les artistes les plus populaires du monde. Les œuvres de Cézanne, Monet, Degas et leurs compatriotes représentent des richesses inestimables. Mais qui étaient-ils vraiment ? Comment et pourquoi ont-ils révolutionné l’histoire de l’art ? Qu’est-ce qui se cache derrière leur succès intemporel ? Pour répondre à ces questions, le documentaire a obtenu un accès unique à une grande exposition mettant l’accent sur le collectionneur d’art parisien du 19ème siècle, Paul Durand-Ruel, l’expert des Impressionnistes qui prit la décision courageuse d’exposer les Impressionnistes à New York en 1886 et ainsi introduire la société américaine à la peinture française moderne.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Le rockeur progressif Rick Wakeman et son grand ami Ian Lavender, célèbre pour son rôle de Pike dans Dad’s Army, s’offrent une joyeuse virée sur les routes secondaires du Norfolk. Accompagnés des experts Raj Bisram et David Harper, ces deux chasseurs d’antiquités sillonnent le comté à la recherche de trésors à vendre aux enchères à Nottingham.Rick découvre d’anciens graffitis médiévaux cachés dans la cathédrale de Norwich, tandis qu’Ian fait un détour vers le nord du Norfolk pour admirer la plus grande collection de soldats miniatures au monde.Mais un sage vieil homme japonais aidera-t-il Ian à triompher aux enchères ?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Tanni Grey Thompson and Jade Jones
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, nous sommes dans le Nord-Est de l'Angleterre avec les grandes paralympiennes en fauteuil roulant Tanni Grey-Thompson et Jade Jones. Tanni, avec son impressionnant palmarès de médailles et de records, est accompagnée de sa jeune protégée Jade, qui débute sa carrière en athlétisme.Avec les experts Phil Serrell et David Harper, la baronne du comté de Durham et Jade, de Middlesbrough, partiront à la recherche d'antiquités à vendre lors d'une vente aux enchères à Harrogate.Tanni tente également sa chance dans la fabrication traditionnelle du verre, tandis que Jade découvre l'histoire de l'homme qui fut un pionnier du design dans la région.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Réputé pour être le créateur de la peinture à l’huile, le peintre flamand Jan van Eyck (1390-1441) est un artiste majeur du 15ème siècle. Il est considéré comme étant le fondateur du portrait occidental qu’il a pratiqué très méticuleusement. Regardez de près la fameux « Portrait d’Arnolfini » exposé à la Galerie Nationale de Londres, le miroir circulaire au fond de la pièce montre le reflet de l’artiste. « La vierge du chancelier Rolin » exposé au Louvre, quant à elle montre une image dans laquelle trois arcs s’ouvrent sur un paysage fluvial.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Masterpiece
programme.desc: Monet est le fondateur de l'impressionnisme, une forme d'art qui met l'accent sur l'expérience de l'instant, la vie moderne et la peinture en plein air. Ce tableau, réalisé lors d'un de ses nombreux séjours aux Pays-Bas, est un élément important de sa quête impressionniste. Charlotte, comme Monet, se rend sur les canaux pour peindre. L'équipe visite l'ancienne maison et l'atelier de Monet à Giverny, en France, et revient avec du matériel utile pour la reconstitution.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: C’est l’un des artistes les plus controversés et pourtant, l’un des plus influents. La collection de Picasso contenait principalement des Renoir. Matisse le vénérait. Monet également. Renoir a été crucial dans la création du mouvement impressionniste, avant de le rejeter totalement pour se lancer dans un genre radicalement différent, avec beaucoup de succès. La Collection Barnes à Philadelphie possède plus de toiles de Renoir que n’importe quelle autre galerie au monde et c’est là que nous tenterons de lever le voile sur l’histoire remarquable de cet incroyable artiste.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Après deux ans d’exposition itinérante, en 2015 "La Jeune Fille à la perle” est retournée au musée Mauritshuis de La Haye. Du haut de ses 350 ans, l’éternelle Jeune Fille a toujours su conserver son aura de mystère et son charme. La preuve, c’est le nombre de curieux (1,2 millions) qui ont accouru pour l’apercevoir lors de son séjour au Japon. Le documentaire cherche à découvrir les nombreuses énigmes de cet extraordinaire tableau et de son créateur mystérieux - Vermeer. Qui était cette fille ? Pourquoi et comment Vermeer a-t-il peint ce tableau ? Venez voyager dans le temps pour découvrir Johannes Vermeer, visiter le charmant musée de La Haye et répondre à toutes ces questions.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Canaletto and the Art of Venice
programme.desc: Canaletto et l’art de Venise, un voyage en immersion dans la vie et l’art du célèbre peintre de Venise. Aucun artiste n’a su mieux capturer l’essence et le charme de cette ville que Giovanni Antonio Canal, plus connu sous le nom de Canaletto. La remarquable collection regroupe plus de 200 tableaux, dessins et eaux-fortes nous permet de partir à la découverte du talent artistique de Canaletto, de ses contemporains et de la ville qu’il a su reproduire avec génie. Le film ouvre également les portes de deux résidences royales officielles, Buckingham Palace et le château de Windsor, pour nous en apprendre plus sur l’artiste et sur Joseph Smith, l’homme qui a fait découvrir Canaletto à la Grande-Bretagne.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Named Euphrosyne, Thalia and Aglaia, they embody mirth, abundance and splendour. They are the Three Graces, daughters of Jupiter and companions of Venus. A very prized subject as early as the Renaissance, it allowed for a triple representation of the female nude in all its ideal beauty. Observe their grace in the painting by Raphael and the delicacy of their veils in Botticelli’s “La Primavera” or in a magnificent work by Cranach recently acquired by the Louvre Museum. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Rediscover the paintings of Jacob Jordaens. This artist is the subject of a special exhibition at the Petit Palais in 2013-1014.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Que faire de nos morts ? Les brûler ? Les enterrer ? Les faire disparaître ? Les garder à portée de visite ? Nous sommes à 70km de Barcelone, derrière le Montserrat. Ici, comme dans toute l’Espagne, on n’enterre pas les morts, on les empile dans des niches, des caveaux superposés. Ainsi, le nouveau cimetière d’Igualada sera l’œuvre d’un couple d’architectes Catalans au tout début de leur carrière, Enric Miralles et Carme Pinos. Un projet surprenant parce qu’il se confond avec le paysage. Le terrain est creusé, habité d’étranges alignements aux parois obliques en béton, recouverts de terre et plantés. Est-ce un bâtiment ? Ou plutôt un lieu ? Un lieu qui s’est enrichi du fait même qu’il n’est pas fini ? Une inscription forte entre architecture du XXème siècle et paysage, entre Le Corbusier et Richard Long.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Top Italian cooks Antonio Carluccio and Gennaro Contraldo are on a Road Trip around East Anglia. Restaurateurs, writers and old friends the ‘greedy Italians’ will be foraging for antiques in the company of experts David Harper and James Braxton. Watch out for some ‘explosive’ bargaining and an extremely tasty risotto! When he’s not shopping Antonio learns about the brave fisherman of Suffolk who saved mariners’ lives while risking their own. And, Gennaro has a trip to take a peek at a very special bird.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Eugene Delacroix.You will discover his labour with The barque of Dante, Portrait of Aspasie, The assassination of the bishop of liege.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Edgar Degas.You will discover his labour with Portrait of hilaire rené Degas, race horses, ballet rehearsal on the set.

programme.title: Video Art

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Narrated by Gillian Anderson, this episode of Exhibition on Screen follows the footsteps of French artists such as Renoir and Monet, the American Impressionist movement forged its own path. Painted over a period of 40 years, these paintings reveal the United States both as a nation and as a creative breeding ground. The history of this movement is closely linked to the love of gardens and the desire to preserve nature in a country undergoing rapid urbanization. This enchanting journey through workshops, gardens and famous sites in the USA, UK and France is a feast for the eyes.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Housing a huge collection of European paintings from the Renaissance at the end of the 18th century, the Alte Pinakothek in Munich brims over with masterpieces. In particular it boasts several paintings by the great Flemish artist, Rubens, such as “The Battle of the Amazons”. Notice as well Durer’s “Paumgartner Altarpiece”, the impressive “Battle of Alexander at Issus” by the painter Altdofer, and also the “Land of Cockaigne” by Pieter Bruegel the Elder. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: William Blake (1757-1827) developed his own complex and personal mythology. He was a pre-romantic British painter, engraver and poet.

programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: The Galleria Umberto I, designed by Emanuele Rocco, stands as one of the last and grandest covered passages constructed in Europe. It serves as a poignant testament to the architectural brilliance of the 19th century.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Degas : une passion de la perfection
programme.desc: Exhibition on screen nous emmène à travers les rues de Paris puis au cœur d’une superbe exposition au Fitzwilliam Museum de Cambridge, dont l’impressionnante collection d’œuvres de Degas est la plus représentative de Grande-Bretagne. Ayant bénéficié d’un accès exclusif à une grande variété d’œuvres rares, le film raconte l’histoire fascinante de la quête de perfection de Degas à travers l’expérimentation de nouvelles techniques et les leçons apprises en étudiant les grands maîtres.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The Impressionists are the most popular group in art history - millions flock every year to marvel at their masterpieces. But, to begin with, they were scorned, penniless outsiders. 1874 was the year that changed everything; the first Impressionists, “hungry for independence”, broke the mould by holding their own exhibition outside official channels. Impressionism was born and the art world was changed forever.What led to that first groundbreaking show 150 years ago? Who were the maverick personalities that wielded their brushes in such a radical and provocative way? The spectacular Musée d’Orsay exhibition brings fresh eyes to this extraordinary tale of passion and rebellion. The story is told not by historians and curators but in the words of those who witnessed the dawn of Impressionism: the artists, press and people of Paris, 1874. See the show that changed everything on the big screen.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Le curieux monde de Hieronymus Bosch
programme.desc: La ville natale de Bosch aux Pays-Bas ne possède pas de tableaux du peintre et pourtant, pour la grande exposition « Visions of Genius » qui a eu lieu à l’anniversaire de sa mort en 2016, le musée Noordbrabants a réussi à réunir la presque totalité des tableaux et dessins de Bosch. C’est en 2008 que le directeur du musée a commencé sa tournée dans les plus grands musées d’Europe et Etats-Unis pour en persuader les directeurs de prêter au musée Noordbrabants leurs œuvres, en échange d’un travail d’analyse et de recherche sur les tableaux en prêt. Ainsi « Hieronymus Bosch. Visions of Genius » a été l’exposition la plus ambitieuse dédiée au peintre hollandais. Ce documentaire sera une plongée dans l’univers étrange et visionnaire de Hieronymus Bosch.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Jean-François Millet (1814 - 1875) was a 19th-century French realist painter, pastellist, engraver and draughtsman. He is best known for his realistic rural scenes.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Tiziano Vecellio dit Le Titien est un maître incontesté de la peinture du 16ème siècle ! Sa renommée dépassa rapidement sa ville natale, Venise, pour s’étendre à toute l’Italie et à l’Europe. Papes, rois et empereurs lui commandèrent des portraits. Innovations techniques, reconnaissance sociale et peintures célébrissimes, à l’image du Concert champêtre ou de la Vénus d’Urbin, jalonnent la vie du Titien. Une vie qui impressionne tout autant par sa richesse que sa longueur. Bonne visite !

programme.title: My little Museum
programme.desc: My little Museum is Art History retold through funny anecdotes and backstage trivias by Alicia Flipo. With her wacky demeanor, her inventiveness and her quirky sense of humor, Alicia stages these small Art tales so that once and for all, you could remember the Big stories!

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Strictly Come Dancing’s Zoe Ball and Ian Waite are quickstepping their way across the south West of England in a bid to turn a profit at auction in Hampshire. Experts Margie Cooper and Paul Laidlaw are on hand to guide. Paul shares a secret with Zoe about buying antique hair brushes. Ian, though, offers dancing lessons to dealers to secure a discount. Lordy! Zoe also hears how one village became world famous for lace production while Ian ends up meeting a giant horse with its own boat.

programme.title: Trésors Volés
programme.sub-title: The Boy with a Soap Bubble, Rembrandt
programme.desc: On the evening of 13 July 1999, a day of celebrations in France, Rembrandt’s *The Boy with a Soap Bubble* disappeared from the Draguignan Municipal Museum. Patrick Vialaneix recounts how he fell in love with this painting at the age of 13. Thirteen years later, the painting continued to haunt him, and he decided to steal it so that he could always have it close to him and talk to it. He therefore hid in a cupboard in the museum, waiting for nightfall to make off with it. He turned himself in to the police in 2014.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The spectacular sculptures and paintings of Michelangelo seem so familiar to us, but what do we really know about this renaissance genius? Who was this ambitious and passionate man? A virtuoso craftsman, Michelangelo’s artistry is evident in everything he touched. Beautiful and diverse works such as the towering statue of David, the deeply moving Pietà in the Papal Basilica of St. Peter and his tour-de-force, the Sistine Chapel ceiling still leave us breathless today.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.sub-title: Emil Bührle collection at the Maillol Museum
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the Emil Bührle collection at the Maillol Museum in Paris.This collection is that of Emil Bührle, a student of art history who became passionate about collecting Monet's works after a visit to the National Gallery in Berlin. He started his collection with works by Claude Monet, but continued to fill it with works by Cézanne, Gauguin... Works that you can observe during this visit.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.sub-title: Red-heads! From Jean-Jacques Henner to Sonia Rikiel
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the exhibition "Red-heads! From Jean-Jacques Henner to Sonia Rikiel" at the Jean-Jacques Henner National Museum in Paris. The theme of red hair seems to be a real subject in 19th century painting. During this visit, you will be able to observe paintings by Auguste Renoir, Edgard Maxence but especially Jean-Jacques Henner and Sonia Rikiel.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Pablo Picasso est l’un des plus grands artistes au monde, et jusqu’à sa mort en 1973, il était le plus prolifique. Comment tout a commencé ? Comment s’est construit Picasso ? Après avoir été trop longtemps ignorées, il est temps de se concentrer sur les jeunes années de l’artiste et son éducation qui lui ont permis d’accomplir l’extraordinaire. Trois villes ont joué un rôle-clé : Malaga, Barcelone et Paris. "Le jeune Picasso" les traverse et explore leur influence sur l’artiste, en analysant des œuvres spécifiques de ses débuts.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Vincent Van Gogh : une nouvelle façon de voir
programme.desc: La vie de Vincent van Gogh reste entourée de mystère : folie, maladie, suicide, les ingrédients pour créer un mythe sont tous réunis. Bénéficiant d’un accès complet et sans précédent aux trésors du Van Gogh Museum d’Amsterdam, ce documentaire met en lumière à la fois l’un des artistes préférés du monde et la collection riche et unique du musée. Découvrez ces merveilleux chefs-d’œuvre sur grand écran pendant que quelques invités y compris les conservateurs de renommée mondiale et des historiens de l’art offrent leurs interprétations et des explications sur le travail de Van Gogh.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Actor and charmer Nigel Havers and his canny, deal-making chum (and ex-agent) Michael Whitehall explore the West Country. Travelling by Bentley and TVR, they’ll have £400 each and expert advice from Margie Cooper and James Braxton. But what will do best at the auction... Nigel’s old cockle bucket or Michael’s tambourine? Plus there’s a trip to see some Bristol Savages and bit of Georgian elegance with the story of ‘The King of Bath’.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Lynne Faulds Wood and John Stapleton
programme.desc: Un Road Trip en couple de célébrités – les journalistes primés John Stapleton et Lynn Faulds Wood.Ils sont rejoints par Thomas Plant et Margie Cooper pour cette aventure. Avec 400 £ chacun, les équipes commencent à Wrightington, dans le Lancashire, et se dirigent vers Stockport pour une vente aux enchères.Lynn et Thomas se retrouvent littéralement jusqu'aux genoux dans des antiquités en cherchant de vieilles boîtes à biscuits, tandis que Margie tente de convaincre John que des lampes rares feront un joli profit.John apprend comment un Américain a révolutionné les transports publics britanniques, et Lynn découvre pourquoi on traite du lait de serpent à Liverpool.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Top Italian cooks Antonio Carluccio and Gennaro Contraldo are on a Road Trip around East Anglia. Restaurateurs, writers and old friends the ‘greedy Italians’ will be foraging for antiques in the company of experts David Harper and James Braxton. Watch out for some ‘explosive’ bargaining and an extremely tasty risotto! When he’s not shopping Antonio learns about the brave fisherman of Suffolk who saved mariners’ lives while risking their own. And, Gennaro has a trip to take a peek at a very special bird.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les animatrices vedettes Nicki Chapman et Jules Hudson s'échappent à la campagne pour partir à la chasse aux antiquités avec Natasha Raskin et Phillip Serrell. C'est une bataille filles contre garçons, chaque équipe disposant de 400 £. Le voyage commence à Wormsley, dans le Herefordshire, puis les deux équipes se dirigent vers le pays de Galles et l'Oxfordshire, avant de finir à North Finchley, à Londres, pour une vente aux enchères.En chemin, les filles rencontrent un fabricant de sabots qui sculpte les chaussures à la main. Pendant ce temps, les garçons se rendent au Herefordshire Light Infantry Museum pour en apprendre davantage sur l’implication du régiment à Gallipoli.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux stars des années 70, le crooner cool Tony Christie et la royauté pop Jimmy Osmond, sont accompagnés des experts Catherine Southon et Margie Cooper. Partant de la ville de Loughborough, dans le Leicestershire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stoke-on-Trent, dans le Staffordshire.Tony profite d'une visite à Coalbrookdale, le lieu où des techniques innovantes ont été développées, marquant le début de la révolution industrielle. De son côté, le passionné de voitures Jimmy s'offre un tour sur le circuit historique de Donington.La grande finale aux enchères comprend un moment de chant en groupe unique en son genre. Mais quel maestro musical remportera la victoire ?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les coachs vocaux et couple marié David et Carrie Grant échangent l'harmonie vocale contre une compétition acharnée d'antiquités. Avec l'aide des experts Will Axon et Mark Stacey, le couple découvre des objets inattendus à vendre lors d’une vente aux enchères dans la campagne du Norfolk.David fait une halte sur un terrain d'herbe en plein cœur de Cambridge, où aujourd'hui les enfants jouent et les chiens se promènent, mais qui était en réalité le berceau du football. Pendant ce temps, Carrie découvre comment Letchworth Garden City a déclenché une révolution dans la conception des villes.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les actrices et amies de Casualty, Susan Cookson et Suzanne Packer, troquent leurs blouses de chirurgie contre une Sunbeam Tiger de 1965 pour se lancer dans une compétition à travers le Nord-Ouest de l’Angleterre, accompagnées des experts James Braxton et David Harper.Susan découvre son côté négociatrice, tandis que Suzanne garde un œil très vigilant sur le budget, cherchant à trouver un objet vraiment ancien.Au fil du voyage à travers le Yorkshire, elles ont l'opportunité de rencontrer une femme très spéciale de Sheffield et de visiter des jardins incroyables avec une histoire fascinante.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this series is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: L'humoriste et animateur Jim Moir et sa femme Nancy Sorrell partent en road trip dans le Kent aujourd'hui.Mieux connu sous le nom de Vic Reeves, Jim apporte sa touche d'humour unique à l'achat d'antiquités. De son côté, Nancy, mannequin et présentatrice télé, sait aussi marchander et elle est très compétitive ! Le couple est accompagné par les experts Charlie Ross et Thomas Plant.Soyez attentif au don surprenant de Jim pour deviner l’âge de presque tout, à Dixon traversant les chutes du Niagara et à une leçon de navigation par longitude.Et surtout, la mystérieuse Mme Parker fera-t-elle son apparition à la vente aux enchères ?

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.desc: Bhakti Flow invite à une expansion de tout votre être grâce à la pratique du bhakti, la dévotion. Cet enchaînement allie équilibre et force, tout en attirant l’attention sur les zones du corps où la tension se dissimule, souvent ignorées. Apprenez à donner de l’espace à votre respiration et laissez-vous porter par le déroulement de la séquence.

programme.title: Home training
programme.desc: This episode of "Home Training" is dedicated to proprioception and balance exercises. Guillaume and Sabrina work on activating the deep muscles, particularly those in the abdominal area and stabilizers. These exercises help sculpt the body deeply, improving balance and muscle definition. Emphasis is placed on the importance of mobilizing stabilizing muscles for a more effective and lasting workout. With a targeted approach, this training aims to strengthen and tone the entire body from within.

programme.title: Namaste Yoga
programme.sub-title: Anahata Flow: Open Hips, Shoulders and Heart
programme.desc: A heart-centered practice, Anahata Flow allows the body to seek the freedom of the sky while unifying with the breath.

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: Évelyne is an estate agent, but she also does interior design. Of course, she doesn't stop there. In any case, our Wonderwoman doesn't shy away, even when it comes to competition. She's like that, Évelyne, she says what she thinks, but she'll have to deal with the theme of “numbers and letters”. Our competitor has to redecorate the office of Sabine, who is far from a novice when it comes to decorating. Sabine is now a teacher, but she still has a pretty clear idea of the style she likes when it comes to interior design.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie reprend la route à bord de sa petite voiture rouge pour faire honneur à l’un de ses fruits favoris : la châtaigne. Julie ira à la rencontre de plusieurs producteurs en Ardèche, cuisinera la soupe traditionnelle de la région aux côtés de la pétillante Marithé. Elle fera aussi la recette des marrons glacés maison, avant de filer en Corse pour travailler la farine de châtaignes et les feuilles de son arbre. Ce périple s’achèvera comme toujours avec une recette de chef astucieuse et cette-fois ce sera Claude Brioude qui s’y collera ! Ce chef aime bousculer les codes et travaillera la châtaigne avec le poisson, deux produits de saison que l’on n’a pas forcément l’habitude de marier.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Direction le Loir-et-Cher pour une chasse à courre encadrée par les équipes de l’ONCFS. Prenons ensuite la route des Vosges pour cuisiner aux côtés de Mauricette une savoureuse gigue de cerf. Allons à la rencontre de Pierre en Côte d’Or où il fabrique des trompes de chasse, un outil indispensable à la vénerie. Julie retrouvera aussi deux chasseurs girondins pour une après-midi de chasse à la tonne dès plus originale avant de rejoindre Joël en Aquitaine pour une autre recette de gibier à plume. Nous parlerons ensuite avec Laurent du métier de piqueux : ce dresseur de chiens destinés à la vénerie. Cette fois-ci ce sera Frédéric Robert qui nous concoctera une recette de lièvre frotté au cacao et cuit dans un sarcophage d’argile.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes you on a bread trail to uncover the dedicated artisan bakers and millers. Her adventure will lead her through the Libourne region, then onwards to the North of France, the Ardèche, and the Aisne, where bakers have transformed bread into a powerful catalyst for social cohesion. While some individuals may avoid bread, particularly due to gluten-related concerns, others have chosen to reposition it at the forefront of the dining experience by championing its nutritional benefits. This commitment is shared by several chefs whom Julie will meet at the conclusion of her expedition.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: If you're a nature enthusiast and a fan of outdoor cooking, the upcoming season is perfect for barbecue enthusiasts! Our journey will take us to Aube, nestled in the heart of the Brévonnes forest, and then to the Massif des Bauges, where grilling and snow create a unique combination. Afterward, we'll explore the Libournais region, where we'll uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area. Just a short distance from the vineyards, we'll arrive at another corner of Gironde, the Blaye region, where the cooking method remains consistent but features a distinctly local ingredient: eel.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: This week, it is 80 kms from the capital, in Fontainebleau, that Julie is putting down her bags. Fontainebleau, a name famous throughout the world, a magical name which evokes for some a forest, for others a castle, a name which still shines with its royal history. The forest of Fontainebleau has inspired the art world since the beginning of the 19th century. Landscape painters such as Corot and Millet drew inspiration for their works there. But Fontainebleau has many other treasures in its bag, and gastronomy is part of its heritage. This is what Julie will discover through three recipes: Quail with grapes, raspberry and poppy pie and crayfish grave.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, pumpkin takes center stage. Luana Belmondo cooks a spiced pumpkin velouté with parmesan shortbread. Next, she prepares pumpkin gnocchi with a creamy cheese sauce.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo invites her friend Eleonora Galasso for a pizza party! First, they'll make homemade dough. Next, they'll cook a capriciosa with anchovies, capers and ham, and a pizza fritta with oregano and tomato sauce.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: The call of the Forest is about discovering places but above all it is about meeting those who protect this priceless heritage. Forests are essential to mankind. They capture CO2, promote the formation of clouds and therefore rain, protect the soil from erosion and provide a habitat for wildlife. From Madagascar, to France, to Cameroon, or even Eritrea, Yann Arthus-Bertrand sets out to discover the most beautiful forests, those who live in them, those who protect them and those who live off them.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Les Héros de la Nature : Sénégal - Partie 1
programme.desc: For this new episode, Yann Arthus-Bertrand travels through Senegal to encounter men and women who dedicate their lives to preserving the environment. One of the major ecological stakes of the country is fishing and the mangrove ecosystem which, like in some many other parts of the world, faces major threats. Yann Arthus-Bertrand presents the struggle of Haidar El Ali, chosen among one of the world’s most active ecologists. He creates protected marine areas and reforests the disappeared mangrove of his country. He’s managed to convince thousands of Senegalese to plant with him ten million mangrove trees.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Defending water is defending life - Part 2
programme.desc: Les océans recouvrent plus de 70 % de la surface de la Terre. La mer est le plus vaste environnement naturel de notre planète et demeure quasiment inexploitée. En Corse, depuis une tour du Capo Rosso ainsi que dans les Calanques de Piana. Aux Galapagos, nous avons réalisé le portrait de Paul Watson, écologiste et co-fondateur de Greenpeace. Ce Canadien au physique de baroudeur a pris la défense des animaux marins. En Corse, dans les Bouches de Bonifacio, le bassin méditerranéen est l'un des plus riches en biodiversité de la planète avec comme objectif de préserver les côtes de l’urbanisation et protéger la vie marine. En Corse, avec la surpêche. Dans le monde, 75% des stocks de poissons sont menacés par la surexploitation. La cause ? La pêche à grande échelle, gaspilleuse et pas assez régulée. En Guinée-Bissau, les Bijagos, c’est un chapelet d’une centaine d’îles, dans ces eaux, le poisson abonde mais pour combien de temps encore ? En Corse, sur les Iles Sanguinaires, près de 50% des.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Let's hit the roads of France to discover shellfish. We'll visit Brittany, then the Normandy coast where fishing is the regional sport, and Corsica, where the far northeast of the island lives to the rhythm of lobster. Julie takes us to cook lobster, crab with a very special recipe, and langoustines.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes us on a journey of spices and aromatic plants. Spices are a call to travel, to faraway lands and to the unknown. On her journey, Julie will introduce us to the famous black pepper.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Honey was the first sweet condiment in history! It has also been known and consumed as a remedy since Antiquity. In France, we find an infinite variety of honey: acacia, chestnut, fir, rosemary, orange, spruce, oak, linden or lavender... We'll cross forests, fields and even towns, as bees also forage in urbanized areas. We'll then cook up emblematic recipes like Vercel gingerbread. Finally, we'll discover the European dark bee. Protecting this 80-million-year-old bee has become the spearhead of some passionate beekeepers.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: A good breakfast is a healthy, balanced meal made up of 5 energy-giving elements: protein, fiber, carbohydrates, healthy fats and hydration. Luana Belmondo offers us a healthy breakfast that will satisfy both salty and sweet palates: oatmeal, avocado and salmon, buddha bowl with chia seeds and seasonal fruit, and vegan pancakes.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo and her Italian friend Alessandra Pierini are preparing a pasta party. They'll be cooking pesto and sharing their tips on how to get it right. They'll also be making pasta saporita, full of color and flavor!

programme.title: The Great Gardening Challenge
programme.desc: In this week’s episode, professional garden design partners Jon Smith and Adam Woolcott take on Catherine and James Burrage from Yorkshire. Their challenge is to deliver amazing garden spaces on a budget of £5000 for the Knightswood Day Care Centre in the heart of the Essex countryside within sniffing distance of the North Sea. The centre offers a lifeline to mainly elderly local people who have physical or mental disabilities or who live alone. With a brief from the centre that includes sensory elements, seating and a potting shed, both teams have ambitious designs but can they complete them in just 2 days?

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: In Scotland, we investigate whether lifestyle, passions, and even abilities can be influenced by ancestral culture. We begin by training with one of the greatest Highland Games athletes of all time, learning traditional events like the caber toss and stone lift—sports rooted deeply in Scottish heritage.We then visit a weaving workshop to create a custom family tartan, connecting lineage and identity through colour and pattern. At the historic grounds of St. Andrews Golf Course, we explore the origins of golf and its cultural significance.The episode ends with a climb on the Balmoral Estate to Prince Albert’s Cairn, a stunning monument overlooking the Scottish Highlands. Here, we reflect on whether heritage shapes more than identity—perhaps even the activities, environments, and traditions we feel drawn to.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: This powerful episode follows a group of Canadian students—many from small, rural communities—as they embark on their first journey outside the country. Cambodia becomes their living classroom, offering lessons rarely found in textbooks.Together, we explore temples, farms, and cultural sites, witnessing their evolving perspectives as they encounter new customs, foods, and ways of life. At Angkor Wat, students learn how history, spirituality, and mindfulness have shaped Cambodian culture for centuries.The transformations are immediate and profound. Students reflect on global inequality, cultural resilience, and what it means to see the world through new eyes. This episode is a celebration of experiential education and the life-changing impact of travel on young minds.

programme.title: The Great Gardening Challenge
programme.desc: This week’s heat sees professional teams from opposite ends of the UK compete as they’re challenged to create amazing spaces in just 2 days on a budget of £5000, for the Care for Veterans’ care home in Worthing, a specialist care home for elderly and disabled military veterans. Experienced garden designers and builders, James Hutchison and Stuart Gibson have travelled to the South Coast all the way from London. While their opponents, Manoj Maldé and Mark Holman, garden designers who collaborate on show gardens together, have only had to travel from Hertfordshire and Kent. With a brief that includes making sure the gardens are wheelchair friendly and low maintenance the teams come up with very different designs. James and Stuart are faced with a potentially disastrous problem they aren’t used to dealing with back in Scotland. But can they resolve it in time and finish their garden?

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: Our Swiss journey begins at the Neuro Culinary Center, where a gastroenterology researcher demonstrates how sugar affects blood glucose in real time. Through hands-on testing, we see immediate physiological responses, sparking conversations about metabolism, diet, and long-term health.Next, we visit the Herb Hotel, where hyper-local alpine ingredients create rich, grounded flavours connected to season and place. We learn traditional cheese-making methods before visiting Salzano, a renowned Green Michelin Star restaurant known for elevating Swiss mountain cuisine.The day ends with a sunset hike up a mountain, finishing with raclette melted over an open flame—a perfect celebration of the region’s flavour, simplicity, and beauty.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: We begin in Nendaz at the MAD Retreat, where Mike experiences aerial yoga, blending strength, flexibility, and mindfulness. From there, we visit a Kneipp hydrotherapy facility, learning how cold water, movement, and contrast therapy support circulation, resilience, and mental clarity.In the UNESCO Moorlands of Interlaken, we explore pristine alpine ecosystems and discover traditional herbal remedies passed down through Swiss generations. The episode culminates in a summit of a Swiss Alp with new friends, celebrating movement, nature, community, and the healing power of mountains.

programme.title: The Great Gardening Challenge
programme.desc: This week it’s the last of the heats and sees a pair of new kids on the block taking on a more experienced and established pair of garden designers. For Millie Souter from London and Max Parker-Smith from Surrey it’s a huge challenge as both of them have only recently graduated in garden design from the prestigious Inchbald Garden Design College so have limited experience of actually creating gardens. Making things even tougher, it’s also the first time the friends have worked together. Opposing them is Nicola Bailey Gibson and Viv Seccombe who bring years of experience designing and building private gardens and award-winning show gardens. The challenge our pairs face is to create amazing gardens for Focus Birmingham Day Care Centre which offers activities and support to people with severe visual and physical disabilities. And they have to do this is just 2 days and on a budget of £5000.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: After a whirlwind 30 days across the globe, Mike and Braeden retreat into nature to reflect on the powerful stories, lessons, and encounters that shaped the season.

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: What will they think of their new interior? How many points will they award? Their score could change everything and completely overturn the current rankings. The final hope for our decorators is to be Valérie Damidot's favourite and win a bonus point. So who will win the competition? Who will walk away with €2,000 and the title of decorating ace? Today is the day of the grand final, before we see the reaction of the owners and find out their scores. Each contestant will find out what the other contestants thought of their decorating choices.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie is offering you a trip to the south of France. Between the Rhone Valley and the Mediterranean, let's discover a fruit that is harvested in November: the olive.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Nous entamerons ce périple près de la Rochelle pour en apprendre un peu plus sur l’élevage des fameuses moules de bouchot mais aussi une technique bien particulière pour les cuisiner. Nous partirons ensuite pour un tour de France des meilleures huîtres : direction Cancale, Arcachon, Montpellier et enfin Oléron pour connaître les différentes méthodes d’élevage et s’y retrouver un peu plus parmi toutes les espèces de l’hexagone. Julie cuisinera une fricassée de berniques, les petits chapeaux chinois qui recouvrent les rochers du littoral mais aussi des palourdes roses méconnues du grand public. Nous poursuivrons notre route dans le Finistère pour rencontrer Sylvain, le seul éleveur d’ormeau du pays puis à Méru où se trouve encore des ateliers magnifiant ce sublime matériau. Le Chef Jean-Marie Baudic nous cuisine les coquilles Saint-Jacques comme personne.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us down a different kind of yellow-brick road, one that tastes of childhood and gourmet delights: the road of sweets. France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Eating flowers might appear unconventional, but we often consume them without even realizing it. Consider artichokes, for instance : they are essentially large, unopened flowers. Capers are the preserved buds of flowers soaked in vinegar, and cloves are dried flower buds. We also find courgette flowers, saffron pistils, orange blossom water used to flavor pastries, and the violet sweets that evoke memories of our childhood. In addition to adding aesthetic appeal and providing a dose of vitamins to our plates, flowers elevate the flavors of a dish and can even serve as a vegetable substitute.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Cap au Nord pour découvrir une ville française absolument incontournable : Lille. Cette ville possède un patrimoine architectural exceptionnel, marchande dès le Moyen Age, citadelle sous Louis XIV, industrielle au XIXe...elle s'agrandit au cours des siècles. Julie ira à la rencontre de ceux qui participent à la renommée de la ville et de la région, et à travers son patrimoine culinaire avec au menu de ce voyage : la recette du coq à la bière, celle du hochepot, et sur une note sucrée, une crème brûlée à la chicorée. .

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo cooks chickpeas. As they originate from the Middle East, she decides to prepare Lebanese recipes. On the menu: fallafel with chickpeas, kumquat, spices and cinnamon, and chard with chickpeas, parsley, mint and bulgur.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo puts Normandy in the spotlight! With the region's president, Hervé Morin, she prepares apples poached in cinnamon syrup, as well as mussels... in her own way.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: How can we reconcile the development needed to sustain the lives of nearly seven billion people with the protection of the Earth's natural resources? Yann Arthus-Bertrand and his team have chosen Gabon to continue their survey of the planet. We'll be discovering the Kongou Falls, the Langoué clearing with their elephant in Gabon. Then in Colombia, we will go on the island of Malpelo with their shark. Back to Gabon we will discover the Minkébé National Park and the bats in Franceville. We will also go to India in Hyderabad, which has convinced farmers to use no pesticides and no GMOs in their cultivation.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Les Héros de la Nature : Sénégal - Partie 2
programme.desc: For this new episode, Yann Arthus-Bertrand travels through Senegal to encounter men and women who dedicate their lives to preserving the environment. One of the major ecological stakes of the country is fishing and the mangrove ecosystem which, like in some many other parts of the world, faces major threats. Yann Arthus-Bertrand presents the struggle of Haidar El Ali, chosen among one of the world’s most active ecologists. He creates protected marine areas and reforests the disappeared mangrove of his country. He’s managed to convince thousands of Senegalese to plant with him ten million mangrove trees.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Défendre l’eau c’est défendre la vie - Partie 2
programme.desc: On se retrouve en Israël dans le désert du Neguev, Elaine cherche des solutions pour lutter contre la désertification. L’objet de ses recherches : les arbres, peu consommateurs d’eau. Au Mali, on retrouve les Dogons : les cultivateurs du désert. Il nous fait découvrir les recettes de son peuple pour gérer l’eau. Dans cette partie du Mali où il ne pleut quasiment jamais. En Palestine, le village de Wadi Fukeen. Un village où les agriculteurs utilisent un système d’irrigation et de partage de l’eau vieux de plus de 300 ans et basé sur le respect et la confiance. Et en Palestine à Gaza où les spécialistes se battent pour sauver des enfants palestiniens rendus malades par de l’eau impropre à la consommation. Dans la Vallée du Jourdain où trois pays en conflit affrontent les mêmes problèmes : le manque d’eau. Au Brésil, dans le château d’eau du Brésil où l’eau, d’une pureté exceptionnelle est menacée par l’exploitation du minerai de fer qui pollue la nappe phréatique. Et à.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Defending water is defending life - Part 2
programme.desc: Les océans recouvrent plus de 70 % de la surface de la Terre. La mer est le plus vaste environnement naturel de notre planète et demeure quasiment inexploitée. En Corse, depuis une tour du Capo Rosso ainsi que dans les Calanques de Piana. Aux Galapagos, nous avons réalisé le portrait de Paul Watson, écologiste et co-fondateur de Greenpeace. Ce Canadien au physique de baroudeur a pris la défense des animaux marins. En Corse, dans les Bouches de Bonifacio, le bassin méditerranéen est l'un des plus riches en biodiversité de la planète avec comme objectif de préserver les côtes de l’urbanisation et protéger la vie marine. En Corse, avec la surpêche. Dans le monde, 75% des stocks de poissons sont menacés par la surexploitation. La cause ? La pêche à grande échelle, gaspilleuse et pas assez régulée. En Guinée-Bissau, les Bijagos, c’est un chapelet d’une centaine d’îles, dans ces eaux, le poisson abonde mais pour combien de temps encore ? En Corse, sur les Iles Sanguinaires, près de 50% des.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, we're off to discover summer fruits, which are harvested from June to August: peaches, melons, strawberries, raspberries... We'll then head to the cherry capital, Céret, and cook blueberries, strawberries and an apricot charlotte.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure. The region is renowned throughout the world for the quality of its wines, particularly those of Chablis. Julie begins her journey in Auxerre and then proposes typical recipes from the area: croquignoles and cherry clafoutis.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo and her pastry chef friend Laurent Favre-Mot prepare desserts from our childhood. On the program: panettone in French toast, and torta della nonna with lemon cream and pine nuts, a typical Italian dessert!

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: The incredible diversity of flora and fauna, the fight against climate change, the balance between growth and sustainable development: these are all battles being fought on five continents. Yann Arthus-Bertrand takes us on this expedition. We're off to Gabon to discover the Ivindo National Park and Port-Gentil, then on to Sri Lanka in Kandi. Back to Gabon we go to Libreville, then Lambaréné to talk about turtles and the health of the local people. Finally, off to Dhaka-Bangladesh.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Dans ce volet, Yann Arthus-Bertrand lève le voile sur les produits achetés par les hommes. Presque tous nos achats ont une incidence directe sur notre environnement. Direction la Japon pour parler de l’impact des nouvelles technologies, puis la république du Congo à Bukavu pour la récolte du coltan. Comment notre consommation totale affecte-t-elle l'environnement ? Quelles marques permanentes imposons-nous à notre planète ? Comment différencier les achats utiles des achats inutiles ?

programme.title: The Great Gardening Challenge
programme.desc: This week it’s the last of the heats and sees a pair of new kids on the block taking on a more experienced and established pair of garden designers. For Millie Souter from London and Max Parker-Smith from Surrey it’s a huge challenge as both of them have only recently graduated in garden design from the prestigious Inchbald Garden Design College so have limited experience of actually creating gardens. Making things even tougher, it’s also the first time the friends have worked together. Opposing them is Nicola Bailey Gibson and Viv Seccombe who bring years of experience designing and building private gardens and award-winning show gardens. The challenge our pairs face is to create amazing gardens for Focus Birmingham Day Care Centre which offers activities and support to people with severe visual and physical disabilities. And they have to do this is just 2 days and on a budget of £5000.

programme.desc: Hainan tropiske regnskognasjonalpark i Kina har et spektakulært plante- og dyreliv. En sunn og livskraftig regnskog er avgjørende for lokalbefolkningens levebrød og velferd.Noen innbyggere bruker kjennskapen til regnskogen som parkvoktere, mens andre bruker planter fra området til å framstille fargestoffer til praktfulle brokader, en tradisjon som har gått i arv gjennom generasjoner. I mellomtiden tar Dr. Brenda kaka for søte tilfeller med et kull på 11 australske gjeterhundvalper på klinikken!

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Våren har kommet, og det er ikke mangel på mammadrama når legene tar seg av tilfeller med nybakte mødre, fostermødre og alt imellom i denne ukens episode med den fantastiske dr. Pol! Denne uken rundes av med morsdag og en overraskelseskake til klinikkens egen matriark: Diane!

programme.title: Afrikas dødeligste
programme.desc: Et spennende blikk på Afrikas farligste og mest skremmende inntrengere.

programme.title: Song of the Rainforest
programme.desc: Hainan tropiske regnskognasjonalpark i Kina har et spektakulært plante- og dyreliv. Her lever også folkegruppene li og hainan-miao, og kunsten, kulturen og livsgrunnlaget deres er uløselig knyttet til dette enestående landskapet. En sunn og livskraftig regnskog er avgjørende for lokalbefolkningens levebrød og velferd.Noen innbyggere bruker kjennskapen til regnskogen som parkvoktere, mens andre bruker planter fra området til å framstille fargestoffer til praktfulle brokader, en tradisjon som har gått i arv gjennom generasjoner. Li-folket er også avhengig av regnskogen for å skaffe materialer til stråtakene på de karakteristiske, båtformede husene sine.

programme.title: Afrikas dødeligste
programme.desc: I tillegg til å være hjemmet til noen av verdens mest avholdte dyr er det afrikanske kontinentet også fullt av brutale rovdyr. Mikroskopiske skapninger med et fryktinngytende våpenarsenal, hvithaiens fryktede kjever, sekretærfuglens dødelige fot og det giftige stikket til skorpionen; vi avslører de ti farligste snikmorderne i Afrika.

programme.title: Noe bet meg!
programme.desc: En orkan fører to svært forskjellige arter på kollisjonskurs ved kysten av Nord-Carolina da noen surfere padler forbi et av verdens eldste og farligste sjødyr. I Fort Collins i Colorado ender løpeturen opp med nærkamp mot et godt utrustet pattedyr.

programme.title: Noe bet meg!
programme.sub-title: Ikke tid til å være redd
programme.desc: I San Gabriel-fjellene utenfor Los Angeles ender et pars romantiske tur med en kamp for å redde liv og lemmer. På drømmeturen på Zambezi blir naturfotografene ofre for et av Afrikas farligste dyr. En tur som begynte med en bursdagsfeiring ender med kampen for å overleve.

programme.title: Noe bet meg!
programme.sub-title: Om hun merker at jeg lever…
programme.desc: I Wyoming feller en jeger en hjort, men samtidig tiltrekkes skogens fremste rovdyr. Etter å ha bekjempet angriperen med en kjøkkenkniv blir jegeren et medisinsk under da kirurgene lapper ham sammen igjen. Et av havets eldste rovdyr endrer en kvinnes liv da hun opplever hvor mye smerte det kan påføre en.

programme.title: Afrikas dødeligste
programme.desc: Afrikas hav huser en rik og mangfoldig bestand av marine dyr. Langs kysten og ned på havdypet finnes det en mystisk og dødelig verden. Her kan jegeren fort bli jaget. I denne episoden ser vi hvordan Afrikas sjødyr overlever med rå kraft, listig adferd og drapsinstinkt.

programme.title: Noe bet meg!
programme.desc: En orkan fører to svært forskjellige arter på kollisjonskurs ved kysten av Nord-Carolina da noen surfere padler forbi et av verdens eldste og farligste sjødyr. I Fort Collins i Colorado ender løpeturen opp med nærkamp mot et godt utrustet pattedyr.

programme.title: Noe bet meg!
programme.sub-title: Ikke tid til å være redd
programme.desc: I San Gabriel-fjellene utenfor Los Angeles ender et pars romantiske tur med en kamp for å redde liv og lemmer. På drømmeturen på Zambezi blir naturfotografene ofre for et av Afrikas farligste dyr. En tur som begynte med en bursdagsfeiring ender med kampen for å overleve.

programme.title: Secrets of the Zoo: Tampa
programme.sub-title: Rhinos, Koalas and Bears... Oh My!
programme.desc: Forelsk deg i asiatiske og australske dyr i Zoo Tampa! I denne spesialepisoden har en malayabjørn time hos tannlegen, et par treleoparder utforsker sitt nye habitat, dyreparken tar farvel med en elsket koala og et neshornpar blir forelsket.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: Pol-familiens må grave ned i bakken for et nytt uthus som skal huse innkommende husdyr, og Charles har fått en spinnvill idé om hva den strukturen kan være - og den kan bare være sprø nok til å fungere. På auksjonen håper Pol-familien på å kjøpe sauer og kyr, men de skyhøye budene truer deres store planer.

programme.title: Ville Argentina
programme.desc: Nord i Argentina finnes Ibera-reservatet med sumper, laguner og et like stort biologisk mangfold som i Pantanal.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: Budgivningen er intens på den store dyreauksjonen! Pol-familien jobber mot målet om å bringe sauer og kyr hjem til gården deres. Eventuelle dyr de vinner vil bli levert til gården i løpet av bare tre dager, så å få sauehytta ferdig i tide er preserende - og det er mye som gjenstår. I mellomtiden er Beth og Charles bekymret for den lave aktiviteten i bikubene deres.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Ecuadorianske Andes krysser ekvator, og området har et enormt biologisk mangfold. Jungeldyr og fjellarter bor side om side, og alle har tilpasset seg til et ekstremt liv i fjellene.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programme.desc: Sør-Amerika er et kontinent med ekstreme variasjoner, der man finner flere hundre tusen kvadratkilometer med skog, sletter og fjell. Det er tøft å overleve her. Noen dyr har utviklet seg til å bli veldig store eller svært små, og begge strategiene skal øke sjansen for å overleve.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Flere hundre kilometer utenfor kysten av Ecuador finnes det en gruppe vulkanøyer som huser noen av de merkeligste livsformene som finnes. Dette er Galapagosøyene, som steg opp fra havet for over 20 millioner år siden. Livet har utviklet seg i isolasjon og ført til en rekke fantastiske skapninger, der mange bare finnes her.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Ecuadorianske Andes krysser ekvator, og området har et enormt biologisk mangfold. Jungeldyr og fjellarter bor side om side, og alle har tilpasset seg til et ekstremt liv i fjellene.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programme.desc: Sør-Amerika er et kontinent med ekstreme variasjoner, der man finner flere hundre tusen kvadratkilometer med skog, sletter og fjell. Det er tøft å overleve her. Noen dyr har utviklet seg til å bli veldig store eller svært små, og begge strategiene skal øke sjansen for å overleve.

programme.title: Ville Argentina
programme.desc: Hvaler, pingviner og sjøløver, som føder unger her, er blant sjødyrene som tiltrekkes av Argentinas 5000 km lange kyststripe. Fra første åndedrag er det én ting som gjelder for ungene: å overleve. Spekkhuggere jakter på unge sjøløver med en spesiell teknikk, mens måker angriper hvalungene. Vi får se dyrenes utrolige adferd gjennom noen fantastiske opptak under vann, noe som gjør Christian Baumasters film til en stor visuell opplevelse.

programme.title: Ville Argentina
programme.desc: I Argentinas fantastiske, men tøffe villmark må dyrene kjempe for å overleve hver eneste dag. Terrenget er karrig og ulendt, lufta er tynn og været kan endre seg på et blunk. En puma sniker seg gjennom dalføret på jakt etter en guanako, mens en tarantell forsvarer seg mot et sultent beltedyr. Revene spiser av byttene de finner inntil en stor rovfugl dukker opp. Samtidig holder isbreene på ferskvannet som dyrene så sårt trenger.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Flere hundre kilometer utenfor kysten av Ecuador finnes det en gruppe vulkanøyer som huser noen av de merkeligste livsformene som finnes. Dette er Galapagosøyene, som steg opp fra havet for over 20 millioner år siden. Livet har utviklet seg i isolasjon og ført til en rekke fantastiske skapninger, der mange bare finnes her.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: To øyer utgjør de siste skansene for regnskogen i Sørøst-Asia. Borneo og Sumatra huser begge noen av verdens mest unike og sjeldne arter. Borneo-elefanter, enorme trær, flygeagamer og rødaper kjemper alle om plassen.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Ekvator strekker seg 4000 kilometer over det afrikanske kontinentet. Artene som finnes her, er like mangfoldige som landskapet. Enorme planteetere og legendariske rovdyr dominerer de karrige gresslettene, mens de sjeldne apekattene trives i regnskogene. Hvert år etterfølges flommen av sult, men dyrene har tilpasset seg til omgivelsene. Dette er Ekvatorial-Afrika, evolusjonens hjerte.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Korallrevene i Asia-Stillehavsregionen er de mest mangfoldige i hele verden. Og de fantastiske skapningene i havets regnskog er avhengige av hverandre for å overleve.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Ecuadorianske Andes krysser ekvator, og området har et enormt biologisk mangfold. Jungeldyr og fjellarter bor side om side, og alle har tilpasset seg til et ekstremt liv i fjellene.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: I denne episoden av The Incredible Dr. Pol har våren kommet til Michigan, og det betyr fødesesong! Det er babybonanza på Pol Veterinary Services, og legene har hendene fulle med nydelig babyer og sinte mammaer. Dr. Pol rakk så vidt å få i seg dagens første kaffekopp før telefonen begynte å dure!

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Det blir en travel uke med falske alarmer, nødssituasjoner til alle døgnets tider og detektivarbeid ved Pols veterinærklinikk. Selv ikke et hestespark i hodet stanser dr. Pol i å rykke ut for å hjelpe dyrene.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Høsten forvandler Karpatenes fjellsider til et bølgende teppe av bronse, ravgult og gull. Skogene fylles av kronhjortenes mektige brøl, som varsler kampen om retten til å samle en flokk med hinder. Oppgjørene er brutale, og de svekkede taperne blir et lett bytte for ulveflokker på jakt etter et enkelt måltid. For bjørnene gjelder det å fråtse i bær og nøtter for å legge på seg før vinterdvalen. Til tross for sin enorme størrelse klatrer de opp bøke- og furustammer for å nå de saftigste nøttene i trekronene. De går også inn på menneskenes åkere for å forsyne seg av mais. De gjør nesten hva som helst for å stille sulten. Alle disse storslåtte dyrenes overlevelse avhenger av de gamle skogene. De gamle trærne binder skadelig karbon fra atmosfæren og bidrar til å regulere jordas klima, en livsviktig funksjon for alt liv.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Alpebukker springer ned fra de bratte klippene, himmelen fylles av millioner av fugler under det imponerende trekket, og midt på vinteren leter den sjeldne gaupa etter en make.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Ecuadorianske Andes krysser ekvator, og området har et enormt biologisk mangfold. Jungeldyr og fjellarter bor side om side, og alle har tilpasset seg til et ekstremt liv i fjellene.
